name: source-stream-current-model
rules: Model positions accept only the current structure; legacy selectors are rejected before dispatch, not stripped or used for fallback.
Selectors inside business input, user schemas or protocol options are business data and must not be recursively rewritten.
Stored historical documents and invocation results remain readable without execution; immutable identity and deduplication evidence are preserved.
Legacy structures are converted offline under the coordinated maintenance and recovery procedure.

excluded: App request and Core messaging rollout
